preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(N >= 1 and M >= 1 and N * M >= 2 for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N and M are positive integers and the grid size N*M is at least 2.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '.#' for c in row) for row in all_grid_rows)
preconditions.description: Every character in the grid is either '.' (empty) or '#' (wall).
The starting cell (1, 1) is guaranteed to be empty (not a wall).

preconditions.expression: sum(N * M for N, M in test_cases) <= 500000
preconditions.description: The sum of N*M over all test cases does not exceed 5*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.
Each output line contains a non-negative integer representing the minimum airstrikes.

postconditions.expression: all(min_airstrikes(grid) == int(output_lines[i].strip()) for i, grid in enumerate(all_grids))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer equals the minimum number of rows that must be selected to destroy walls such that a path exists from (1, 1) to (N, M) in the modified grid.
